definition_or_use: Export unit value index (2015 = 100). Proxy the price of the aggregate export bundle.
limitation: Unit-value indexes also reflect quality and within-bundle composition; they are not pure fixed-quality prices.

definition_or_use: Fuel exports (% of merchandise exports). Measure fuel dependence in exports.
limitation: Resource rents and broad export shares do not identify how export proceeds finance imports.

definition_or_use: Total natural resources rents (% of GDP). Identify resource-intensive economies.

limitation: Resource rents and broad export shares do not identify how export proceeds finance imports.

definition_or_use: Current account balance (% of GDP). Distinguish trade deficits from broader external deficits.

definition_or_use: GDP (current US$). Scale trade and investment by the size of the economy.

definition_or_use: Imports of goods and services divided by population; a direct measure of how much the country buys abroad per person.
limitation: A nominal purchasing measure; compare it with import volume indexes to separate prices from quantities.

definition_or_use: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP). Scale total imports by GDP.
limitation: Goods-and-services trade and merchandise trade use different accounting frameworks and should not be mixed in one identity.

definition_or_use: Exports minus imports of goods and services.
limitation: Uses the accounting definitions and coverage of the component WDI series.

definition_or_use: Goods-and-services trade balance divided by GDP.

definition_or_use: Merchandise imports divided by population.

definition_or_use: Population, total. Convert aggregate flows to per-capita measures.
